_why: The one switch for what the public site serves. "offline": true publishes only the plain notice (tools/site-notice.json), as /, /play/, /bench/, /band/ and 404.html, and copies nothing of the web export. To bring the playable site back: set "offline" to false AND "approved" to the date of Orb's word, with a recorded full-set pass of the pixel check for the commit (tools/flash/release-pass.json); build-site.mjs refuses to build the playable site otherwise. CI exports and checks the build either way. Orb's order, 2026-10-06.
